What We Did: Removed the title/salutation field (Mr/Mrs) from the customer form to keep it simple.
Replaced the old name fields with one 'Last name / Company name' field that works for both people and businesses.
Added a dropdown to mark a customer as a Fleet account or a Single customer.
Moved credit-card details into the Billing section as one tidy block and removed the old separate card fields.
Added a mailing address with a 'same as billing' checkbox so you don't have to retype it.
New customers default to Ontario, the usual province, to save typing.
Replaced real-sounding example names in the form with neutral placeholders.
Split phone numbers into clear Cell, Business and Home fields.
The customer and vehicle forms now use a clear 'Save' button.

Task: Package shows as one total on the invoice
What We Did: On the customer's invoice a package appears as a single bundled total, listing the items but not their individual prices.

Task: Add multiple packages to a job
What We Did: A single job can now include more than one package.
Transmission and differential services can be included inside packages on jobs.
Added two new staff roles — Supervisor and Technician — for more precise job assignment and access.
Staff can sign in with a simple username instead of an email address.
Rebuilt the screen where an Admin turns each page on or off for a user, so access is easier to manage.
Inventory now tracks how many of each part are on hand at each shop; only senior roles can change the counts.
Added an easy start/end-time picker (hour, minute, AM/PM) to record when a job started and finished.
Added an email field to the customer record.
Expense costs can be entered with extra decimal places for accurate part costing.
Each user has a profile page to update their name and change their password.
The 'customer-supplies labour' fee and counter premium can be set on each individual part, not just one global value.
Moved the vacation-pay setting out of Pricing and into Payroll, where it belongs.
Split the MHSW environmental fee into what you pay (Buy) and what you charge the customer (Sell).
Jobs have a dedicated Labour line so labour is recorded separately from parts.

Task: Pick service/labour items on a job
What We Did: You can choose predefined service/labour charges from a list when building a job.

Task: Choose price tier when adding a part
What We Did: When adding a part to a job you pick which price to charge: With Service, Without Service, or Over the Counter.
The Advisor dropdown shows only people who work at that job's location.
Changing an item's quantity inside a package updates that line's total automatically.
Created an 'Admin' account type with access to everything, including Settings.
The Owner runs the business but no longer sees Settings — that is now the Admin's job.
Managers can view customers and data across every location, not just their own.
Supervisors also get all-location access by default.
Tidied up the login page layout.
The MHSW fee is now built into a part's cost and shown consistently everywhere.
Fixed the math so Sell MHSW is added to the cost first, then the margin is applied, then the list price is worked out.
Reordered the part fields to Buy MHSW, Sell MHSW, then Cost for a clearer entry flow.
Defined the Over the Counter price as the part's list price.
Defined the With Service price as total cost plus the service charge.
Defined the Without Service price as linked labour plus the list price.
Renamed the confusing 'Counter premium' field to the clearer 'Service charge'.
Updated labels across the app to read 'Over the Counter'.
The service charge can be set to a negative number so it can act as a discount.
The MHSW amount now appears as its own column on jobs and printed invoices.
Sped up the parts catalogue so it loads and scrolls smoothly even with thousands of parts.
Staff can create and edit sales jobs at their own location.
A free-grease-only job is no longer shown as an unpaid invoice; the free grease is recorded as a $0 line.
You can record different details and multiple account numbers for a vendor at each location.
On a new expense, after choosing a vendor and location you pick which of that vendor's accounts to use.
Invoices pull the correct shop name, address, phone, fax and HST number from the job's location.
Merged the separate 'Description of Work' and 'Parts' sections into a single clear table on the invoice.
Double-checked that invoices show the correct location, HST number and date.
The oil-change price grid now lists only engine oils, hiding coolants and transmission fluids.
Reorganised the left menu into clear groups: day-to-day operations, then pricing, then finance.
Added loading spinners so it's obvious when a search is running.
Each part shows whether it is Active or Inactive, with a button to switch.
You can double-click a part row to open it for editing.

Task: Better customer search on new job
What We Did: Improved customer search on a new job — find people by licence plate, name, or any phone number, with clearer labels.
The activity log shows who changed what and when — including parts and pricing — and was fixed so entries actually show up.
Long tables now keep their header row visible while you scroll.
Added All / Active / Inactive tabs to filter the parts list.

Task: Warn before deactivating a stocked part
What We Did: If you deactivate a part that still has stock on hand, the system warns you first.
While typing a part number, the system warns you if it already exists.
A part marked 'bundled in a package' shows $0 on its own; if added to the same job again it uses the Over the Counter price.
Removed the tiny up/down arrows on number boxes so they aren't clicked by mistake.
In the job editor you can see and edit each package item's quantity and price, and the bundle total updates.

Task: Remove an item from a package
What We Did: You can remove an individual item from a package on a job; the package total adjusts to match.

Task: Add oil as a job line
What We Did: You can add an oil grade directly as a job line — choose bulk or gallon, set litres and price.
A job can record several payments (e.g. part cash, part card).
The free-grease offer can only be used once, within the customer's first 30 days.
Staff can only edit a job on the day it was created, and every job shows when it was last edited and by whom.
You can enter a negative price on a job line to apply a discount or credit.
Pressing Enter in a field no longer saves the form by accident — you save with the Save button.
The Upper and Lower technician dropdowns show only people at the job's location.
Fixed the With Service price so it still calculates correctly when the service charge is negative.

Task: Engine list filtered by vehicle make
What We Did: The engine list for oil-change auto-pricing is filtered to the vehicle's make (and shows all if none match).
Reworded the package upgrade/credit popup in plain language so it's clear what it does.
A 'Save and add new job' button takes you straight from creating a customer into a new job.

Task: Vehicle carried into the new job
What We Did: When you use 'Save and add new job', the vehicle is saved and pre-selected on the new job.
Made 'Add vehicle' a clear button that opens an add-vehicle window right on the job and then selects the new vehicle.
The system blocks saving a vehicle whose licence plate or VIN already exists.
While typing a customer name, the system warns you if a similar customer already exists.
On an expense you can pull parts from the catalogue and see each part's last buying price.
You can search those expense parts by number, brand or description.
Oil grades are listed alphabetically by name; the manual sort-order field was removed.

Task: Remove a package item keeps the package total
What We Did: Removing an item from a package on a job no longer lowers the price — the item's value stays in the package (a package is a fixed-price deal).
A part marked 'bundled in a package' now shows $0 as its With Service price (was Without Service), since the package covers it.
The start/end time picker now lets you pick any minute (00–59), not just 15-minute steps.

Task: Prices rounded up to .99 on jobs
What We Did: When building a job, each single part, each package total, and the sub total round up to end in .99 (e.g. 12.34 becomes 12.99). Sales only.

Task: Fixed line items duplicating on new jobs
What We Did: Fixed a bug where double-clicking an add-item button could add the same item twice when creating a job.

Task: Package items shown without individual prices
What We Did: On a job a package lists its items by name only (no per-item price); only the package total is charged.

Task: Highlighted Vehicles section on new-customer form
What We Did: The new-customer form's Vehicles area is now a highlighted block with a bold Add vehicle button so it isn't missed.
Accountants can now create a new payroll week, add entries, approve it, and record payments — not just Owner/Admin/Manager.
Added a dedicated Employees page (list, add, edit, activate/deactivate) so employees actually show up to pick from on a payroll entry — this was the cause of 'can't select employee'.
Staff can see their own payroll history on a personal My Pay page, linked to their login account.

Task: Payroll weeks start Sunday + bi-weekly option
What We Did: Payroll weeks now start on Sunday (was Monday) and can be created as weekly or bi-weekly.
Turning a page on/off for a user now updates their menu right away — no more needing a hard refresh to see the change.
Removed the manual sort-order field from the technicians list; it's now just alphabetical, matching the oils list.

Task: Duplicate-customer warning links to the record
What We Did: When the system warns you a similar customer already exists, the name is now a clickable link straight to that customer.
The Engine size field on Add Vehicle now auto-capitalises as you type, matching plate/VIN/make/model.

Task: Oil line shows gallon vs litre correctly
What We Did: An oil line on a job now correctly shows 'gal' when you picked gallon, instead of always showing litres.
Added a clear 'Add return / credit' button to a job's line items, so a returned part can be entered as a negative line.

Task: Add Trans & Diff service directly to a job
What We Did: Transmission & differential services can now be added straight onto a job as their own line, not just inside a package.
The Trans & Diff price list can now be edited in-app (add/edit services and prices) instead of needing the owner to change it elsewhere.
Added a tick-box on each part: when checked, that part's price rounds up to the next .99 when added to a sale. The old rounding that applied to everything was removed per your request.
Fixed an error that blocked a cross-location manager from saving a vendor's per-location account details.
Inventory now has a separate Oils tab tracking per-location oil stock, alongside the existing Parts tab.
Added a Print button and clean print layout to all the pricing list pages (filter list, all-filter price, trans & diff, oil grid, oil detail).
The oil-change auto-pricing engine dropdown now filters by the vehicle's actual engine size instead of just its make, for a more accurate match.
Fixed missing Add entry / Approve / Cash / Record payment buttons for accountants on the payroll week detail page.
Removed the 'All' tab from the parts catalogue — just Active and Inactive now, defaulting to Active.

Task: Keyboard shortcut to save a job
What We Did: You can now save a job from anywhere in the form with Cmd/Ctrl+Enter.

Task: Negative price can be typed directly
What We Did: Fixed a bug where you couldn't type a minus sign into a line's price box — negative (credit/return) prices now type normally.

Task: Time picker fixed for repeated digits
What We Did: Fixed the start/end time picker so typing a repeated digit (like 22, 33, or 44) sets the right value instead of cycling to the wrong number.

Task: Promotions — add a discount to a sale
What We Did: New Promotions feature: create named percent or fixed-dollar discounts (e.g. 'Spring 10% off') and add them as a line on a sale.

Task: Promotions — add a discount to an expense
What We Did: Promotions can also be added as a discount line on an expense, not just a sale.
Fixed the With Service price so it properly includes the Sell MHSW fee, matching the Without Service and Over the Counter prices on the same basis.

Task: Package parts priced at cost; labour is separate
What We Did: Finalised how packages are priced: each part in a package charges its cost only, and the package's labour is charged once as its own separate line — so labour is never counted twice.
Fixed the search box on the Filter price list — it wasn't filtering results properly; it now searches part number, description and brand reliably.
Added a Print button to the Parts catalogue so you can print or save a clean parts price list.
The printed invoice header no longer shows the shop name twice — just the logo and one clear location name.

Task: Vendor save no longer fails silently
What We Did: Saving a vendor across multiple locations no longer stops partway through on the first error — it now saves everywhere it can and clearly lists any location that failed.

Added an actual 'Merge vendors' tool: pick a primary vendor and one or more duplicates, and everything (locations, accounts, parts, expenses, invoices) moves onto the primary, which is the only one left afterward.

Task: Promotions can be marked taxable or not
What We Did: Promotions now have their own taxable/exempt tick-box (like parts). By default a promotion is non-taxable, so the discount is applied after tax.
Buying a catalogue part on an expense now automatically increases that part's stock count at the expense's location — no more manual stock entry for purchases.
A part can now have several customer-supplies labour prices instead of just one; all of them show on the All Filter Sell Price page.

Task: Trans & Diff: two oils per service
What We Did: A transmission/differential service can now use two different oils, each with its own price, plus a 'default' choice for which one is charged on a job.
Added Bulk / Gallon / Pail as a container choice on Trans & Diff services.
The sell price on a Trans & Diff service now auto-fills from the oil's cost and quantity when you pick the oil, container, and litres — still editable by hand.
Coolant flush services now display their quantity in gallons instead of litres.
The app can now be installed on desktop and mobile like a native app, with quick shortcuts for New sale, New expense, Inventory and Dashboard right on the icon.

Task: Oil detail: only real engine oils listed
What We Did: The oil selector on the Oil detail page no longer lists transmission/differential/fuel fluids — only actual engine oils, matching the oil-change grid.

Task: Oil detail: cost = filter + oil + tier
What We Did: Corrected the Oil detail cost breakdown so 'Total cost' is filter + oil + tier only; labour is shown as its own separate column and counted as profit, not cost.

Task: Oil line priced from the base grade
What We Did: When adding an oil to a job, the price now comes from the base oil grade's rate rather than the specific oil picked, so pricing stays consistent.
The login screen now shows 'Quick Truck Lube' instead of the longer 'Quick Truck Lube & Oil'.

Task: 'Add labour/service' picker removed from New Job
What We Did: Removed the separate labour/service-cost picker button from the New Job line items — 'Add labour' (free-form) stays.

Task: Vendor merge keeps the duplicate's details too
What We Did: When merging vendors, if the primary is missing a contact number, email, account #, category or note that the duplicate had, it's now copied over instead of lost.
Fixed the per-part round-off so a checked part shows its rounded .99 price consistently in the add-part popup and price lists, not just after it's added to the job.
Fixed a regression: a part marked 'bundled in a package' correctly shows $0 as its With Service price again when added on its own to a job (Without Service / Over the Counter still charge normally).
